Frozen snapshot-platform and post-menu packaging counterexamples and corrections are preserved. Semantic types, ordinary suites/builds and native visual/consumer acceptance remain unrun. No actual files/system identity/windows/menu commands/user data or credentials operated; no whole-file MIT or clean-room claim. See docs/knorvia-root-about-menu-20261003.md.

Current exact-head CI: dd963aae58aa6111e5c65532c30c152c040de30a, Actions run 37080878699, Linux and Windows fail at file provenance inventory. Dependency install, typecheck, lint, format, architecture, build and offline regression are skipped. This is an unresolved inventory gate, not a runtime test result or merge readiness. No bypass or full rerun requested.

The manager has one state-owning factory and six private modules; all seven drafts froze before deliberate manager-body review. Three paired fake-port safety groups and API/lint/architecture checks pass. Original sender/command capture regressions and lint warning are retained with corrections. Scoped types/API/lint/architecture pass. Retained regex/format/schema/projection expression is explicit. No full suites/builds or real userdata operations. See docs/knorvia-root-preview-merge-20261003.md.

Client transport batch: complete MessagePort disposal and WebSocket connection/event/socket adapters now have frozen functional-packet-authored candidates, post-freeze same-root source review and scoped semantic types/API/lint/architecture checks. RemoteServiceAccess stays unchanged descriptor facade. No runtime/native tests or builds; no live connections/userdata/auth changes. Original type/harness failures are retained. See docs/knorvia-root-client-transport-20261003.md.

SSH progress batch: complete read-only file-size/error/label helpers and per-upload throttle/deduplication owner added from G's body-free packet. Frozen draft and post-freeze source review are recorded; public declarations, scoped types/lint/architecture pass. No runtime tests/builds were run; no real SSH, filesystem user data, credentials or permission changes. Config-only agentOfficialPluginAssets remains unchanged. Same-root review, not separate review or legal clearance. See docs/knorvia-root-upload-progress-20261003.md.

New CDN/network batch: eight pure CDN functions and the transport selector now have complete contract-first replacements, frozen draft and static API/type/lint/architecture evidence. Source review found an omitted sparse-array traversal edge; three loops were corrected after freeze, while other existing quirks remain. No runtime tests/builds were run for this batch. The tiny fetch selector is ordinary contract-bound glue with no separate originality credit. See docs/knorvia-root-cdn-20261003.md.

Latest update: cache refresh-sharing, legacy directory admission and pre-fetch staging gates were corrected with minimal synthetic counterexamples. The subsequent structural partition ran only static types/lint/syntax-identity checks, not another runtime suite. See docs/evidence/root-remote-cache-20261003/refresh-stage-correction.json and split-proof.json. Full acceptance remains deferred.

Root's sixth independent development lane owns the four remoteAssetCache modules, remoteAssetCdn.ts and remoteAssetNetwork.ts and sshUploadProgress.ts, the two packages/client transport adapters, the two shared preview/message projections, three desktop lifecycle owners, three desktop scan/preview owners, three window/tray/command owners, three startup/deep-link owners, two IPC helper/admission owners and the remote-session lifecycle manager with six private modules, three about/menu owners, plus their bounded specifications/authoring evidence. No other lane is merged; the earlier combined local WIP is outside this scoped source checkpoint.

The complete 35,741-byte draft was frozen before target implementation/history/test-body comparison, from the curator's functional/API packet and existing public declarations. Root has broader project context; earlier generic repository scanners may have processed filesystem bytes without presenting this implementation body. The curator was source-exposed. This is a qualified authorship candidate, not an absolute clean-room or MIT determination.

The owner covers eleven public functions and five interfaces: manifest parsing/reference preservation, retained and refreshed request ownership, content/legacy cache identity, sequential component downloads, archive integrity, migrations, staged replacement/rollback, partial release publication, hardlink materialization, markers and progress. Collaborators outside this root-owned cache/CDN/network scope are unchanged.

Only minimal verification ran: scoped target compilation passed using actual installed dependency declarations and explicit Node types; three synthetic actual-emitted data-safety groups passed (manifest identity/validation, pinned ready partial publication, failed forced download preserving existing cache). No real network, credentials, user caches or remote servers were used. The original draft's type-annotation failures and subsequent type-only correction are preserved.

The original 997/400 line gate is now closed by a four-module partition. Scoped types and lint pass; all 55 function declarations, 16 public exports and five interfaces are preserved, and all five mutable maps remain in the original main module. This maintenance split adds no originality credit. Full migration/refresh-concurrency/rollback/platform/runtime/build acceptance and final source-expression/licence review are deferred. No full suite was run. Root licensing inventory and project licence remain unchanged.

Exact draft, context limits, contract, digests and check records: docs/evidence/root-remote-cache-20261003/. Keep this PR draft and independent until all lanes are collected for final acceptance; no main merge or deployment.
